system.description:
Usage worn cloak; Weight 2 lbs.

Its fabric is made from hundreds of narrow strips, each dyed according to a different era or tradition. The wearer occasionally remembers how to fasten clasps that have not existed for centuries.

You gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against magical memory alteration and effects that suppress or alter personal identity.

You also gain the Borrowed Experience ability:

Borrowed Experience:

Activate Concentrate (1 AP)

Frequency 1/day

Select one skill in which you possess no ranks. For 10 minutes, treat yourself as possessing 1 rank in that skill. This grants access to skill actions requiring 1 rank but does not satisfy prerequisites for feats, classes, archetypes or other permanent character options.

If you are Rhevani, you instead treat yourself as possessing 2 ranks, subject to your normal maximum ranks.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on saves against memory and identity effects; Use grants 1 rank (a Rhevani: 2) in a skill you have none in, for 10 minutes (1/day).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
